title: Who Munib Tracker is for
intro: Munib Tracker is for any Muslim who wants to be more consistent in worship. These pages show how it fits a few common situations, and where it doesn't.

cta.title: Wherever you're starting from
cta.text: Munib Tracker is free, private and works offline. Try it for a week and see what changes.
